response_json.request: Change that vertical slot to cut through complete body to decrease weight

actions.operation: Change the existing slot cut extent
actions.relational_constraint: The slot cut must pass through the entire body.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the referenced vertical slot and the complete body through which it must cut.
steps: Localize the vertical slot in the curved hook and support-body section R02. The slot visible in the +Z front view is the front-side elongated relief pocket F008, recessed from z=0 mm to its blind floor FACE 23 at z=-10 mm.

Recognize that F008 is aligned with the corresponding back-side relief pocket F007. F007 extends from z=-42 mm to its blind floor FACE 18 at z=-32 mm. The two pockets have the same x-y profile and leave a central material web between z=-32 mm and z=-10 mm.

Modify F008 rather than creating an unrelated opening. In a feature-history model, edit the pocket feature and change its termination from a 10 mm blind depth to a Through All extent through SOLID 0 along the negative z direction.
If direct feature editing is unavailable, select the front broad side wall FACE 28 at z=0 mm as the sketch support plane and orient the sketch normal along the z axis.

Recreate or project the existing rounded vertical-slot perimeter defined by FACE 19, FACE 20, FACE 21, and FACE 22. Preserve its current position and geometry: x=104 to 122 mm, y=31 to 79 mm, nominal width 18 mm, and radius-9 mm semicircular ends.

Create a subtractive extrusion from the front face through the complete local body thickness. Use a Through All termination, or an explicit cut depth greater than the full z thickness of 42 mm, so the cut passes from z=0 mm through to the back surface at z=-42 mm.

Ensure the subtraction removes the existing front-pocket floor FACE 23, the central web between the two blind pockets, and the back-pocket floor FACE 18. The existing side-wall faces FACE 19 through FACE 22 and FACE 14 through FACE 17 will be replaced or merged into continuous through-slot walls.

Do not alter the slot width, rounded-end radii, x-y location, external curved spine F005, open hook throat F006, mounting base R01, or upper interface head R03. No additional fillet is required because the slot profile already incorporates radius-9 mm rounded ends.
Recompute the part and verify that the result remains one connected solid, SOLID 0, with a continuous opening visible from both the +Z front view and the -Z back view.

Inspect the resulting wall thickness around the through slot and confirm that the cut does not break through the adjacent outer wall or hook clearance. Confirm that the removed central web produces the intended mass reduction while retaining the surrounding upright load path.

intention: Decrease the weight of the body.
